ui.extra.cacheClean:
1. Confirm that you opened Miliastra Wonderland Odes history in Genshin Impact; if "User authentication expired" still appears, try the steps below
2. Close the Genshin Impact game window
3. Click "Open cache folder" above to open the Cache folder
4. Delete the Cache_Data folder
5. Launch Genshin Impact and open Miliastra Wonderland Odes history
6. Close this dialog and click "Update"
ui.extra.findCacheFolder: If "Open cache folder" does not respond, manually open "Your game install folder/Genshin Impact Game/GenshinImpact_Data/webCaches/Cache/"
